senses.gloss:
घोर घोर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. हन्
with substitution of घुर् for हन्), venerable, awful,
sublime (in these senses Ved); terrific, frightful, terri-
ble, horrible, dreadful, awful, violent, vehement; (अस्),
m. the terrible, an epithet of Śiva; N. of an Āṅgi-
rasa, a son of Aṅgiras; N. of Kutsa; (आ), f. the night;
a kind of creeper, = देव-दाली; (scil. गति), N. of
one of the seven stations of the planet Mercury;
(अम्), n. venerableness; awfulness, horror; a horrible
action, magic formulas and charms; poison; saffron;
[cf. धीर and गौर.]
—घोर-घुष्य, अम्, n.
brass; (a various reading for घोर-पुष्प); [cf.
घोष.]
—घोर-चक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of
frightful appearance, having terrific eyes.
—घोर-
तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more terrible, very awful.
—घोर-
ता, f. or घोर-त्व, अम्, n. horribleness, horror.
—घोर-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, of horrible or fright-
ful appearance, terrific; (अस्), m. an owl.
—घोर-
पुष्प, अम्, n. brass, bell-metal; [cf. घोर-
घुष्य.]
—घोर-रासन, अस्, m. a jackal; (a
wrong reading for घोर-वाशन.)
—घोर-रासिन्,
ई, m. a jackal (? for घोर-वाशिन्).
—घोर-रूप,
अस्, ई, अम्, frightful, hideous; (अम्), n. a hideous
appearance.
—घोर-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, frightful, hor-
rible, hideous.
—घोर-वर्पस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of
frightful or hideous appearance of shape; an epithet
of the Maruts.
—घोर-वाशन, अस्, m. or घोर-
वाशिन्, ई, m. a jackal; [cf. घोर-रासन.]
—घोर-
सङ्काश, अस्, आ, अम्, dreadful, terrible.
—घोर-
स्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, of dreadful sound.
—घोराकृति
(˚र-आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, frightful, hideous, of terrible
aspect or form.
घोरक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
